this_run_demonstrates: Mode 3 IS buildable and runnable on current main of all four repos (tari, minotari-cli, minotari_payment_processor, base node)
Mode 3 architecture works at the wiring level - all components found each other and the API endpoints, DB, base node, PR all interoperate
The single bug breaking Mode 3 at production is Finding #11 - the unsigned-tx version mismatch between the constructing tool (minotari-cli) and the signing tool (console_wallet)
API-side ingestion throughput at the PP boundary is ~5,000 payments/sec (10 in 5 ms; 100 in 19 ms; both round-trips include DB write of all PaymentReceived rows)
